name: EarningFarm ENF ETH vault withdraw share-burn reentrancy
summary: EFVault.withdraw() computed the shares to burn, had the controller pay the receiver in ETH, and only then capped the burn at the caller's current balance. In the ETH callback the attacker moved its shares to a helper, so withdraw burned almost nothing and the helper withdrew again with the same shares; repeated until the strategy was drained.
notes: The last of three pre-exploit upgrades restored the vulnerable implementation; the route change resets the age even though the code was the same as at creation.
Campaign: the attacker repeated the reentrant withdraw nine more times, and two copycats repeated it after; no other vault of the deployer runs this implementation.
The strategy's Aave stETH collateral is listed net of the WETH debt repaid while unwinding it, so the asset value is the ETH the withdrawals paid out beyond the attackers' deposits.
